### `app/surveys.py`

> app/surveys.py — 动态 survey 发现 (唯一真源)。

- **`derive_survey_id(filename: str) -> str`** — 从上传文件名派生唯一 survey_id。voucher 默认两份保留映射。
- **`list_surveys() -> List[str]`** — 列出当前真正可用的 survey_id。
- **`default_survey() -> Optional[str]`** — 当前默认 survey: 最新修改的 db 文件,fallback 到第一个可用。
- **`survey_suffix(survey_id: str) -> str`** — report/charts 文件后缀。历史 survey1→s1 / survey2→s2 保留;其他直接用 id。
- **`is_valid_survey_id(survey_id: str) -> bool`** — 合法性:字母数字下划线,且 ≤ 48 字符。不要求已存在(set_plan 时还没清洗)。

### `app/tools.py`

> app/tools.py — Tool implementations for the analysis agent.

- **`load_plan() -> Optional[dict]`** — Read the active analysis plan, if one has been set.
- **`survey_suffix(survey_id: str) -> str`**
- **`set_analysis_plan(surveys, modules, compare=False, focus='', state=None) -> Dict`** — Validate (Pydantic) and persist the agent's analysis plan.
- **`preview_data(file_path: Optional[str]=None, n_rows: int=5, state=None) -> Dict`** — Read first N rows of an Excel/CSV file.
- **`get_variable_catalog(survey_id: Optional[str]=None) -> Dict`** — Read variables table from SQLite.
- **`run_clean(target: str='all', source_file: str=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — Run clean_to_sqlite.py to import Excel → SQLite.
- **`run_generic_ingest(survey_id: str, source_file: str, state=None) -> Dict`** — Generic ingest for ANY survey schema: dumps Excel/CSV into sqlite raw_data
- **`run_analysis_module(module: str, survey_id: Optional[str]=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — Run a single Rscript analysis module on the resolved survey scope.
- **`run_selected_analysis(modules: list, survey_id: Optional[str]=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — Run multiple analysis modules in sequence on the resolved survey scope.
- **`get_results(module: str, survey_id: Optional[str]=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — Read the actual computed numbers from a module result (.rds → JSON).
- **`run_compile(state=None) -> Dict`** — Run compile.R to merge all .rds files into compiled.rds.
- **`run_report(state=None) -> Dict`** — Render Quarto HTML report.
- **`check_pipeline_status(state=None) -> Dict`** — Check module completion **relative to the active plan**.
- **`read_log(n_lines: int=30) -> Dict`** — Read last N lines of pipeline.log.
- **`dispatch_subagent(role: str, task: str, context: str='', state=None) -> Dict`** — 以 role 对应的 subagent 系统提示运行一次性 LLM 调用,产出该任务的专业建议。
- **`interpret_results(module: str, survey_id: Optional[str]=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — 读取 module 的 RDS,转 JSON 投给 LLM,在 ModuleInterpretation schema 约束下生成解读。
- **`render_charts(module: str, survey_id: Optional[str]=None, state=None) -> Dict`** — 渲染指定模块的图表到 output/charts/<module>_<sid>/。
- **`generate_word(template: str='standard', survey_id: Optional[str]=None, title: str='问卷调查分析报告', org_name: str='调查分析平台') -> dict`** — 生成 Word 报告 (.docx)
- **`generate_pdf(template: str='standard', survey_id: Optional[str]=None) -> dict`** — 生成 PDF 报告
- **`export_charts_bundle(survey_id: Optional[str]=None) -> dict`** — 打包导出所有图表 + 缩略图 PDF
- **`list_report_templates() -> dict`** — 列出可用报告模板
